senses.definition: to take something away from a place, or get rid of it
senses.example: Please remove your shoes before entering.

senses.definition: a person who is responsible for running a business or leading a team
senses.example: Ask the manager if you need help.

senses.definition: to get pleasure from doing or experiencing something
senses.example: We enjoyed the concert last night.

senses.definition: a group of connected people, things, or computers
senses.example: The computers are linked by a network.

senses.definition: to meet people for work contacts or connect computers
senses.example: She networked with other teachers at the event.

senses.definition: relating to the law or allowed by it
senses.example: You should seek legal advice before signing.

senses.definition: relating to a religion, or believing strongly in one
senses.example: They celebrate several religious holidays.

senses.definition: having a low temperature, or not showing warmth or friendliness
senses.example: It's cold outside today.

senses.definition: low temperature, or a common illness with a runny nose and cough
senses.example: I caught a cold last week.

senses.definition: coming at the end, with nothing more after it
senses.example: This is our final decision.

senses.definition: the last game in a competition or an important exam at the end of a course
senses.example: Our team reached the final.

senses.definition: more important or larger than the others
senses.example: The main reason is the cost.

senses.definition: the study of the natural world through observation and testing
senses.example: She studies science at school.

senses.definition: having the colour of grass, or causing less harm to the environment
senses.example: We bought a green bicycle.

senses.definition: the colour of grass, or an area covered with it
senses.example: The walls were painted green.

senses.definition: the ability to remember, or something remembered from the past
senses.example: That song brings back happy memories.

senses.definition: a small flat piece of paper or plastic used for information, payment, or games
senses.example: I paid for the meal by card.

senses.definition: higher than something, or more than a number or level
senses.example: The picture hangs above the sofa.

senses.definition: in a higher place or in an earlier part of a text
senses.example: Please see the example above.

senses.definition: mentioned earlier in a piece of writing
senses.example: Please follow the above instructions.

senses.definition: a place to sit, or a position held in an elected group
senses.example: Is this seat taken?

senses.definition: to give someone a place to sit or have room for a number of people
senses.example: The hall seats two hundred people.

senses.definition: the smallest living unit, a small room, or a unit that produces electricity
senses.example: The human body contains many kinds of cells.

senses.definition: to start an organization or system, or show that a fact is true
senses.example: They established a new school in the town.

senses.zh: 令人愉快的；友善的；不错的
senses.definition: pleasant, kind, or enjoyable
senses.example: It was nice to meet your family.

senses.definition: a test of something, or a legal process that decides whether someone is guilty
senses.example: The medicine is being tested in a clinical trial.

senses.definition: a person who knows a great deal about a subject or skill
senses.example: Ask an expert before making repairs.

senses.definition: having a high level of skill or knowledge
senses.example: She gave us expert advice.

senses.definition: the season after winter, a metal coil, or water flowing from the ground
senses.example: The flowers appear in spring.

senses.definition: to move suddenly or come into existence quickly
senses.example: The cat sprang onto the wall.

senses.definition: a business company, especially one providing services
senses.example: She works for a law firm.

senses.definition: not soft or easy to move, or strongly decided
senses.example: We need a firm plan before we start.

senses.definition: a person who supports democracy; with a capital D, a member of a party called the Democrats
senses.example: She described herself as a democrat.
senses.note: 泛指支持民主的人通常小写 democrat；美国民主党党员大写 Democrat。

senses.definition: sound programmes sent through the air, or a device used to hear them
senses.example: I heard the news on the radio.

senses.definition: to go to see a person or place for a period of time
senses.example: We visited our grandparents on Sunday.

senses.definition: an occasion when you go to see a person or place
senses.example: We enjoyed our visit to the museum.

senses.definition: the work of controlling an organization or process, or the people who do it
senses.example: Good time management helps students.

senses.definition: to keep away from something or prevent it from happening
senses.example: Try to avoid making the same mistake again.

senses.definition: to form an idea or picture in your mind of something not present
senses.example: Imagine living by the sea.

senses.definition: during the evening or night of today
senses.example: We are going to the cinema tonight.

senses.definition: the evening or night of today
senses.example: Tonight is a special night.

senses.definition: very large in size, amount, or degree
senses.example: The project was a huge success.

senses.definition: a round object used in games, or a large formal dance
senses.example: The children played with a ball.

senses.definition: the person being spoken to, especially when doing or receiving the action
senses.example: Did you make this cake yourself?

senses.definition: to come to the end of something or complete it
senses.example: Please finish your homework before dinner.

senses.definition: the end of a race or activity, or the final surface of something
senses.example: The runners were close to the finish.

senses.definition: an idea that explains how or why something happens, based on thought or evidence
senses.example: The theory explains why the disease spreads.

senses.definition: a strong effect on something, or the force of one thing hitting another
senses.example: The new rule had a big impact on families.

senses.definition: to have a strong effect on someone or something
senses.example: The changes will impact local schools.

senses.definition: to say or do something as a reply or reaction
senses.example: She responded quickly to my email.

senses.definition: something said or written to give information, or a document showing financial activity
senses.example: The company issued a short statement.

senses.definition: to keep something in good condition or continuing, or to say firmly that something is true
senses.example: It is important to maintain a healthy balance.

senses.definition: money asked for a service, an accusation, or electricity stored in something
senses.example: There is no charge for delivery.

senses.definition: to ask someone to pay, put electricity into a device, or accuse someone officially
senses.example: How much do you charge for delivery?

senses.definition: liked by many people or common at a particular time
senses.example: This book is popular with young readers.

senses.definition: following ideas or ways of doing things passed down over time
senses.example: They cooked a traditional meal.

senses.definition: to a position on the surface of something
senses.example: The cat jumped onto the table.

senses.definition: to make something known or visible that was hidden before
senses.example: The report revealed a serious problem.

senses.definition: the way something points or moves, or instructions on what to do
senses.example: We drove in the wrong direction.

senses.definition: a country in central Europe
senses.example: She moved to Germany last year.

senses.definition: an object used to hurt people or fight
senses.example: Police found a weapon at the scene.

senses.definition: a person who is paid to work for someone else
senses.example: The company has fifty employees.

senses.definition: to have something inside, hold it, or stop it from spreading
senses.example: This bottle contains one litre of water.

senses.definition: relating to the ideas, customs, or arts of a group of people
senses.example: The city has a rich cultural history.

senses.definition: a title used before the name of a married woman
senses.example: Mrs Brown teaches our class.
senses.note: 现代英语中也常用不表婚姻状况的 Ms；称谓以本人偏好为准。

senses.definition: a situation without war or fighting, or a feeling of calm
senses.example: They hope for peace after years of war.

senses.definition: a bad feeling in part of your body or in your mind
senses.example: She felt a sharp pain in her back.

senses.definition: to make someone feel sad or hurt
senses.example: It pains me to see them argue.

senses.definition: to ask formally for something, use something in practice, put it on a surface, or be relevant
senses.example: She applied for a new job.

senses.definition: having a large distance from one side to the other, or covering many things
senses.example: The river is very wide here.

senses.definition: as far or as much as possible from one side to the other
senses.example: Open your eyes wide.

senses.definition: to find the size or amount of something, or judge its value
senses.example: We measured the room before buying furniture.

senses.definition: an action taken to achieve something, or a way of finding size or amount
senses.example: The school introduced new safety measures.

senses.definition: to move quickly from side to side or make something do so
senses.example: The building shook during the storm.

senses.definition: a quick movement from side to side, or a cold sweet drink
senses.example: Give the bottle a good shake.

senses.definition: to move through the air or travel in an aircraft
senses.example: Birds fly south for the winter.

senses.definition: a small insect with wings
senses.example: A fly landed on the table.

senses.definition: a meeting in which someone is asked questions for a job or information
senses.example: She has a job interview tomorrow.

senses.definition: to ask someone questions for a job or to gather information
senses.example: The reporter interviewed the actor.

senses.definition: to be in charge of something, or succeed in doing something difficult
senses.example: She manages a team of five people.

senses.definition: a seat with a back, or the person who leads a meeting
senses.example: Please sit in this chair.

senses.definition: to lead a meeting or committee
senses.example: She chaired the meeting on Monday.

senses.definition: an animal that lives in water and breathes through gills, or its meat as food
senses.example: We had fish for dinner.

senses.definition: to try to catch fish
senses.example: They fish in the lake on weekends.

senses.definition: one specific person or thing, or very careful about what you like
senses.example: Is there any particular reason for the delay?

senses.definition: a detail or piece of information about something
senses.example: We need the particulars of the agreement.

senses.definition: a device used to take photographs or record video
senses.example: She took a picture with her camera.

senses.definition: the way parts of something are arranged, or a building
senses.example: The structure of the report is easy to follow.

senses.definition: to arrange the parts of something in a planned way
senses.example: She structured the course around weekly topics.

senses.definition: activities and ideas about how a country or group is governed
senses.example: She is interested in local politics.

senses.definition: a small piece or amount of something; in computing, a basic unit of information
senses.example: Could you wait a bit longer?
senses.note: bit 也可作 bite（咬）的过去式，但不是独立的动词原形。

senses.definition: to entertain people on stage, carry out a task, or work in a particular way
senses.example: The singer performed in front of a large crowd.

senses.definition: how heavy someone or something is, or a heavy object used for exercise
senses.example: What is the weight of this package?

senses.definition: to make something heavier or give more importance to some parts of it
senses.example: The final score is weighted toward the exam.
senses.note: 动词常见于 weighted（加权的）等形式。

senses.definition: quickly and unexpectedly
senses.example: The lights suddenly went out.

senses.definition: to find something or learn a fact for the first time
senses.example: Scientists discovered a new species of bird.

senses.definition: a person being considered for a job or elected position, or taking an exam
senses.example: She is a strong candidate for the job.

senses.definition: the process of making goods, a film, or a show; the amount made
senses.example: The factory increased production this year.

senses.zh: 对待；看待；治疗；处理；请客
senses.definition: to deal with someone or something in a certain way, give medical care, or pay for someone's enjoyment
senses.example: Please treat everyone with respect.

senses.definition: something enjoyable that feels special, or an occasion when someone pays for another person's food or fun
senses.example: A trip to the beach is a special treat for us.

senses.definition: the part of the day after the afternoon and before you go to bed
senses.example: We went for a walk in the evening.

senses.definition: a journey, often short, or an act of falling after catching your foot
senses.example: We took a day trip to the coast.

senses.definition: to catch your foot on something and fall or almost fall
senses.example: I tripped over a bag in the hall.

senses.definition: to change something or have an effect on it, or make someone feel strong emotion
senses.example: The weather can affect our plans.

senses.definition: the way a person's emotions appear to others
senses.example: The doctor noted his flat affect.
senses.note: 名词义主要用于心理学和医学；日常常见的是动词。

senses.definition: in or into the inner part of a place
senses.example: Come inside and have some tea.

senses.definition: within a place or object
senses.example: The keys are inside the bag.

senses.definition: the inner part of something
senses.example: The inside of the box was painted red.

senses.definition: on or relating to the inner part
senses.example: The inside door was locked.

senses.definition: a large formal meeting where people discuss a subject
senses.example: She spoke at a science conference.

senses.definition: one separate part of a larger group, a standard amount, or a group of soldiers
senses.example: This book has ten units.

senses.definition: a particular way of doing or making something, or its appearance
senses.example: I like her writing style.

senses.definition: to shape or arrange hair, clothes, or other things in a particular way
senses.example: She styled her hair for the party.

senses.definition: a person who is fully grown
senses.example: Children must be with an adult.

senses.definition: fully grown, or intended for grown people
senses.example: This course is for adult learners.

senses.definition: to feel anxious about something or make someone feel anxious
senses.example: Don't worry about the test.

senses.zh: 担心；烦恼；令人担忧的事
senses.definition: an anxious feeling or a problem that causes it
senses.example: Money is a constant worry for them.

senses.definition: to say or write something briefly without giving many details
senses.example: She mentioned your name in the meeting.

senses.definition: a brief statement about someone or something
senses.example: There was no mention of the change.

senses.definition: the limits between two points, a variety of things, or a line of mountains
senses.example: The shop sells a wide range of books.

senses.definition: to vary between stated limits
senses.example: Prices range from ten to fifty dollars.

senses.definition: going far down or in, or strong and serious
senses.example: The water is too deep to stand in.

senses.definition: far down or far into something
senses.example: She breathed deep and slowly.

senses.definition: the outer line of something, the sharp side of a blade, or a small advantage
senses.example: Don't stand near the edge of the cliff.

senses.definition: to move slowly and carefully toward a place
senses.example: She edged toward the door.

senses.definition: clearly named or described, rather than general
senses.example: Do you have a specific question?

senses.definition: a person who writes books, articles, or other texts
senses.example: She is a writer of children's books.

senses.definition: a problem or difficulty that causes worry or extra work
senses.example: I had trouble finding the address.

senses.definition: to worry someone or cause them difficulty
senses.example: I hope this doesn't trouble you.

senses.definition: needed in order to do something or achieve a result
senses.example: Is it necessary to book in advance?

senses.definition: in every part of a place or during the whole of a time
senses.example: It rained throughout the night.

senses.definition: in every part or at every time
senses.example: The room was clean throughout.

senses.definition: something difficult that tests your ability, or a question about whether something is right
senses.example: Learning a new language is a challenge.

senses.definition: to invite someone to compete or question whether something is true
senses.example: She challenged the decision in court.

senses.definition: a strong feeling that something bad may happen
senses.example: She has a fear of heights.

senses.definition: to feel afraid of someone or something that may happen
senses.example: Many people fear losing their jobs.

senses.definition: the part of the body between the neck and upper arm
senses.example: She carried the bag on her shoulder.

senses.definition: to accept responsibility for something or carry it on your shoulder
senses.example: The team shouldered the extra work.

senses.definition: an organization with a public purpose, or an established way of doing things
senses.example: The bank is a major financial institution.

senses.definition: the part at an equal distance from the ends or sides
senses.example: She sat in the middle of the room.

senses.definition: between the beginning and end or between two sides
senses.example: The middle child is ten years old.

senses.definition: a large area of salt water
senses.example: We swam in the sea every day.

senses.definition: images and events in your mind during sleep, or something you strongly hope for
senses.example: Her dream is to become a doctor.

senses.definition: to see images while sleeping or hope strongly for something
senses.example: I dreamed of travelling around the world.

senses.definition: a place serving drinks, a long narrow piece, or something that prevents entry
senses.example: We met at a bar after work.

senses.definition: to prevent someone from entering or doing something
senses.example: The rule bars children from the area.

senses.definition: very pleasant to look at, hear, or experience
senses.example: They visited a beautiful garden.
